cards.subject: sociology
cards.front: What happens to the defining features of a social movement over the course of its life?

reasons: review:Front says "the defining features" without naming them (points at unseen text) and the answer "they may change" is guessable trivia; the real content is the features list itself.

cards.front: Name the distinct modes of protest that social movements develop, as NCERT lists them.

source.book: Social Change and Development in India

cards.subject: sociology
cards.front: Social change vs social movements: how do they differ?
cards.back:
Social change is continuous and ongoing.
Social movements are directed towards some specific goals.

reasons: review:kind difference: back joins two non-contiguous sentences (drops the middle sentence); spec allows fragment-joining only for list/steps/types. Use the full quote or a true substring.

cards.subject: sociology
cards.front: When you try to classify a social movement as redemptive, reformist or revolutionary, what do most movements have?

cards.subject: sociology
cards.front: According to NCERT, why does the perception and classification of a social movement differ from one section to another?

cards.subject: sociology
cards.front: Why, according to NCERT, are many of the new social movements international in scope?

cards.subject: sociology

cards.subject: sociology

cards.subject: sociology

cards.subject: sociology
cards.front: According to NCERT, whose concerns differ from the educated middle class woman's, and from the Dalit woman's?
